market_reference: Arrow Electronics, your direct competitor in component distribution, has partnered McLaren since 2019 and is the F1 team's Official Technology Partner. Its engineers work side by side with the race team and its branding runs on the McLaren cars and drivers, which gives Arrow a showcase for its engineering support in front of the same buyers.
shared_values: An F1 team depends on suppliers who deliver the right parts on time and help its engineers make them work. Macnica Galaxy supplies chips, AI servers and software to manufacturers and backs them with its own engineers.
flags: Capacity: firm caution. Listed on the Taipei Exchange (6227). Consolidated revenue was NT$24.2bn for January to October 2026, up 61% on a year (monthly data on Yahoo Finance Taiwan), driven by AI server demand, but distribution margins are thin and aggregators showed a market value of only about NT$6.3bn (dated, not confirmed). A budget of this size would likely need sign-off from the parent, Macnica Holdings (Japan).

China: subsidiary Macnica Galaxy International (GFEi) is based in Hong Kong with offices in mainland China since 1992. HQ is Taiwan, so no China HQ override; Shanghai is listed because GFEi serves mainland customers. Suzuka is in the Macnica group's home market, Japan, not a Macnica Galaxy market; drop it if the user wants only the brand's own countries.
